fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on alleged graft and political influence in Miami, public-utility contracts and rates, and high property tax assessments. Reports and opinion pieces address Miami Beach transportation disputes involving jitneys and proposed railway agreements, and the delayed repair of the Baker's Haulover bridge. Additional items cover law enforcement and court matters (including vagrancy and costs), hunting restrictions affecting Seminole Indians, a satirical prohibition-agent report from the Everglades, and community notes, advertisements, and entertainment listings.
